Blue_Mold.quote: Symptoms of blue mold include chlorotic lesions on the tobacco leaf and bluish-gray sporangiospores on the underside of the lesions.

Brown_Spot.quote: The spots are roughly circular, with necrotic centers and concentric rings and often surrounded by a yellow halo.

Frogeye_Leaf_Spot.quote: Spots occur mostly on the lower leaves, near the ground, because old, mature leaves are more susceptible than young and apical growing leaves.

Leaf_Mosaic_Virus.quote: light green, yellow, or white mottling on leaves that may resemble symptoms of some nutrient deficiencies

Phytophthora_Blight.quote: At the ground level, a dark brown to black lesion often appears on the stem.
Symptoms of black shank include root and crown rot, wilting, leaf chlorosis, stem lesions, and pith necrosis.
